ut.title: Weld Seam Testing UT
ut.description: UT for weld seams to detect internal irregularities.

mp.title: Magnetic Particle Testing MP
mp.description: MP to find surface defects in ferromagnetic materials.

et.title: Eddy Current Testing ET
et.description: ET for detecting surface and slight subsurface defects in conductive materials.

vt.title: Visual Testing VT
vt.description: VT for direct observation of surfaces to identify defects or characteristics.

pt.title: Penetrant Testing PT
pt.description: PT uses colored or fluorescent penetrants to reveal surface defects.

offshore.title: Approval for NDT Testing in Offshore Sector
offshore.description: Newly approved for NDT testing offshore, DNV Supervisor Level III and II, operators Level I available.

jobs.title: We are hiring full-time as soon as possible

faqs.question: What are the main tasks in this job?
faqs.answer: You will support us with material testing both domestically and internationally, mainly in Northern Germany.

faqs.question: What qualifications should I bring?
faqs.answer: Flexible, athletic, technical background and English skills are an advantage. A class 3 or B driver’s license, ideally with BE, is required. Certification as an NDT inspector at least Level 1 (UT, PT, MP, VT, ET) would be beneficial.

faqs.question: Can I apply without specific prior knowledge?
faqs.answer: Yes, all further necessary skills and knowledge can be learned with us.

faqs.question: What does this position offer me?
faqs.answer: The job is very varied, you will be part of a highly motivated team, there are opportunities for further training and an attractive salary model.

about.title: About us
about.description: We offer extensive expertise in non-destructive material testing (NDT) such as PT, UT, MP, VT, and ET, as well as a broad range of services and technologies in wear protection and repairs – especially for ON- and OFFSHORE areas. Our customer base ranges from commerce, industry, and shipping to many service providers such as shipyards, shipping companies, power plants, and more. Our services also extend to industries like automotive, aerospace, research institutions, trades, government agencies, zoos, agriculture, the medical sector, and beyond.

philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.text: Our company philosophy includes repair and maintenance, as well as value preservation and enhancement. Services are individually tailored to each business situation. If necessary, standardized and flexible procedures are also used.

guarantee.title: Guarantee
guarantee.text: We stand by the quality of our work and guarantee the highest standards in all our services. Our years of experience and ongoing training ensure reliable results.

method.title: Method
method.text: Use our expertise to reduce your costs. Our mission is to support customers with high-quality products and sound technical knowledge. We offer comprehensive situation analysis, preliminary diagnostics, improvement suggestions, material selection, and technologies to protect components from wear, corrosion, heat, and other influences.

service.title: Services
service.text: Worldwide – around the clock. We offer 24/7 consulting, repair, maintenance, sales, and delivery. You can rely on us – anytime, anywhere.
